problemStatement.formal: Relate Wolstenholme-style congruences, Bernoulli numbers, regular primes, and Fermat Last Theorem criteria.
problemStatement.plain: Formalize the triangle of connections between Wolstenholme primes, Bernoulli numbers, regular primes, and FLT.
whyMatters: Shows where Wolstenholme congruences meet Kummer regular-prime theory
Records deep number-theoretic dependencies explicitly as axioms

proven: Regular and irregular primes are defined through Bernoulli-number divisibility.
The complementarity of regular and irregular primes is proved.
Irregular primes are shown to block the Kummer route in the axiomatized framework.
open: Replace Kummer criterion, Bernoulli-harmonic connection, Wolstenholme-Bernoulli equivalence, and Wiles FLT axioms with formal proofs.
Computationally verify concrete irregular-prime cases in Lean.
knownResults.goal: Record the completed axiomatized Wolstenholme/FLT connection formalization.
